text: 证监会核准博迈基金管理（中国）有限公司作为合格境内机构投资者从事境外证券投资管理业务，公司应当据此办理变更业务范围手续
text_en: CSRC approves Neuberger Berman Fund Management (China) Co., Ltd. as a qualified domestic institutional investor to engage in overseas securities investment management business; the company shall complete procedures to change its business scope accordingly
